Diagnosis: `failed()` always issued a second refund, even when the refund and ledger entry had already succeeded and a later marketplace call failed.
Fix:
- Skip compensation when a refund ledger entry already exists.
- Preserve compensation for genuine pre-refund failures.
- Record the actual BillingHub refund amount.
- Validate compensation responses before recording the ledger entry.
Validation: `./vendor/bin/phpunit` passes.

Implemented the money-safe compensation fix in [SettleSubscriptionJob.php](/app/var/workspaces/double-refund--laravel-13--1/app/Jobs/SettleSubscriptionJob.php).
Diagnosis: `failed()` always issued a second refund, even when the refund and ledger entry had already succeeded and a later marketplace call failed.
Fix:
- Skip compensation when a refund ledger entry already exists.
- Preserve compensation for genuine pre-refund failures.
- Record the actual BillingHub refund amount.
- Validate compensation responses before recording the ledger entry.
Validation: `./vendor/bin/phpunit` passes.
